chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Yusuf al-Baghdadi narrated that Ali ibn Muhammad quoted on the authority of Abul Qasim Muhammad ibn Al-Abbas ibn Musa ibn Ja'far al-Alawi and Darim ibn Qabeesa an-Nahshali that Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (peace be upon him) narrated that he had heard his father quote on the authority of his father, on the authority of his grandfather Muhammad ibn Ali, on the authority of Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon him), on the authority of his father and Muhammad ibn al-Hanifiyya, on the authority of Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) that he had heard God's Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) say:
"Wear agate rings, for it is the first mountain which confessed to the Unity of God the Exalted, the Prophethood of My Prophet, the Trusteeship of you, O Ali! (and for your followers in Paradise)."

key_terms.الْعَقِيق: Agate, a semi-precious stone often used in rings

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of wearing agate rings according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the Imams of Ahl al-Bayt, elevates the wearing of agate (aqiq) rings by linking the stone to the primordial acknowledgment of Tawhid by the first mountain. It specifically connects this physical act to the spiritual hierarchy of the Prophet, Imam Ali’s unique Wilayah, and the ultimate reward for the Shias, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the tangible connection between creation and divine authority.
